semiconductor_relevance: High — Hokuriku Machinery Trading (Suzhou) Co., Ltd specializes in various semiconductor manufacturing equipment and processes.
summary: Hokuriku Machinery Trading (Suzhou) Co., Ltd provides a range of equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, including backgrind, slicing, and polishing tools, as well as chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) and deposition systems. Their offerings cater to multiple stages of semiconductor fabrication and assembly.
capabilities: Slicing and dicing equipment for semiconductor wafers
Deposition systems including CVD and PVD technologies
Cleaning and washing equipment for assembly and packaging
